title: Three Seasons and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：victory　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 victory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the coach ① won the victory that no player in the field would have noted, and he said the winning was the whole of the season. The ② victory, meaning the win itself and not the whistle, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a victory, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ victory in that field had the same short whistle beside it, and the ④ victory at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A victory, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the coach said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the victory was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the win. The ⑥ victory, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; victory, he said, is either something you win or the only word that means both a win and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ victory had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ victory of the whole thing, the coach wrote in April, was one field and three seasons of noting; victory, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ victory I remember is the win noted in the record, which closed in 1973 and is still noted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ victory, my mother said in 1975, is the only win that improves by being noted; every victory, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like a win. She said the honour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 胜利（指球场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 胜利（指那场胜利本身，与小小的哨子相对）
C. 固定搭配：win the victory 赢得这一场胜利
D. n. 胜利（指留给孩子们喊的那一个）
E. n. 胜利之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的胜利之事）
F. n. 胜利（指赛事记录里写到、被记下的那一场）
G. n. 胜利、荣光（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 荣光（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: won the victory that no player in the field would have noted
The victory, meaning the win itself and not the whistle
the victory at the far stand
the victory was the whole of the matter
the victory had become a line in a record
The victory of the whole thing
A victory, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: win the victory 意为“赢得这一场胜利”，1966 年那位教练把球场里没有一位队员肯记下的一场胜利做了一遍。
victory 意为“胜利”，指那场胜利本身而不是小小的哨子，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记下。
victory 意为“胜利”，指球场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一只小小的哨子。
victory 意为“胜利”，指最远那面看台的留给孩子们喊的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
victory 意为“胜利、荣光”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场荣光就是那件事的全部。
victory 意为“荣光”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场胜利，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
victory 意为“胜利”，指赛事记录里写到、被记下的那一场，到 1971 年这一场成了赛事记录里的一行。
victory 意为“胜利之事”，教练四月写道，整件事的胜利之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记下。
victory 意为“胜利”，我记得的是赛事记录里记下过的那一场，1973 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一场。
victory 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，胜利是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的胜利。
